name: Rock Creek (Clinton)
blurb: Blue-ribbon creek east of Missoula. Fast, woody, and closed to boats after June 30.

sections.notes: The Dalles boulder garden. Boats prohibited July 1–Nov 30. Scout wood every spring.
Classic spring salmonfly float. Strainers are the hazard, not rapids.
Short lower-creek run onto the Clark Fork. Tamarack is an unmarked option near mile 4.
